This is a recorded CPU small-model telemetry example, not a robot evaluation or a
production-profile result. Seed 17, batch 4, horizon 8, five synthetic scheduler
steps [4,3,2,1,0], start ratio 0.4, guide/diversity scale 1, forced FKD resampling.
It was produced by the current RDT policy implementation with inexpensive model,
environment and provider substitutes. The wrapper tests also construct explicitly
synthetic batch-20 profile records to exercise offline validation only.
